verdict.rationale: Smooth publishes an official repository named smooth-sdk under circlemind-ai, and its quickstart shows building against a client object (`smooth_client.run(...)`), advertised as running a task in 4 lines of code. Custom tools, which let you pass arbitrary functions, and structured outputs via `response_model` also imply a code-level SDK beyond the raw REST API. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages and package installation instructions, dedicated SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
